column1: # Phase 5d reviewed route classes for the modern /webui-modern slice.
# The frozen legacy contract's network-classes.tsv describes four Tomcat 9
# contexts and the ZK 3.6 AU route. The modern runtime deploys /webui-modern and
# the Phase 4 /ADInterface only, so its route classes are a different set and are
# frozen here rather than compared against the legacy file.
# Every request the capture makes is classified by
# ModernWindowExtraction.routeClass and the resulting set must equal this file
# exactly. A request that matches no class is reported as `unclassified` and
# fails, so a new route cannot be absorbed into an existing bucket.
# class
